Project summary

At Inorbit Mall, Vadodara, Siddh Sai Corporation delivered multiple work packages: RCC roads, plastering, false ceilings, fabrication, Birla putty finishing and flooring. A major mall is unforgiving: finishes are seen by thousands of shoppers, and work has to fit around a strict commercial programme.
